answer: One jade route carries each relic from registration to settlement, and three checkpoints stamp it along the way. Each identity sends a single relic wandering down the route, backed by a 400,000 POA bond. Two relics carrying the same three stamps belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both bonds pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
